title: 4K turnaround plate, crisper
description: Re-render a reference plate sharper and with finer detail, identical in every design element (the Tripo 4K plate prompts).

body.subject: Recreate this exact image as a sharp, high-resolution 4K product turnaround plate.
body.action: Keep everything identical to the reference: the same {{view}} orthographic view, the same scale, position and silhouette, the same armour design - {{design_inventory}}, and the same colours ({{palette}}). Do not add, remove, move, mirror or restyle anything; only render it crisper and with finer surface detail.
body.constraints: Centred on a plain pure black background, no text, no shadow on the ground.

design_inventory.default: every lion head, the gold filigree lines, rivets, roundels, belt studs, tasset plates, the red cloth folds and embroidered meander hems
design_inventory.description: the design elements that must survive

palette.default: dark bronze plates, orange antique gold, deep red cloth, black inner lining

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio
